capabilities.name: Evolution Packet data model
capabilities.evidence: Unit tests construct evidence, hypotheses, mutations, replay results, and packets.
capabilities.limitation: Decision Capsule and Outcome Receipt are currently free-form strings.

capabilities.name: Promotion gate from replay evidence
capabilities.evidence: Unit tests verify positive delta + zero regressions + zero risk flags.
capabilities.limitation: The default gate is intentionally simple and does not weight evidence confidence.

capabilities.name: Behavior PR Markdown renderer
capabilities.evidence: CLI smoke test renders examples/evolution_pr.json into reviewable Markdown.
capabilities.limitation: It renders a review artifact; it does not yet open a GitHub pull request automatically.

capabilities.name: Clean wheel install and packaged playground
capabilities.evidence: CI builds a wheel, installs it in a fresh virtualenv, runs the CLI, and serves the packaged frontend.
capabilities.limitation: This proves packaging and startup, not compatibility with every third-party agent stack.

capabilities.name: Deterministic baseline/candidate command replay
capabilities.evidence: CI executes real subprocess pairs from examples/replay_suite.json and checks outcomes.
capabilities.limitation: It is command-based replay, not yet a captured world-state/time-travel runtime.

capabilities.name: Falsifiable probe contracts per hypothesis
capabilities.evidence: Trace compilation emits intervention, expected result, falsifier, and holdout guidance for each ranked hypothesis.
capabilities.limitation: Probe text is deterministic guidance; only attached replay results provide executable evidence.

capabilities.name: Multiple mutation surfaces
capabilities.evidence: The data model accepts skill, prompt, policy, router, memory, tool, and eval surfaces.
capabilities.limitation: EvoPR does not yet apply each mutation surface to a live agent automatically.

capabilities.name: Evidence types and confidence
capabilities.evidence: Evidence kind/verdict/confidence are represented and confidence bounds are validated.
capabilities.limitation: Different evidence kinds are not yet assigned calibrated weights in causal selection.

capabilities.name: Rollback reference and activation scope
capabilities.evidence: Mutation objects store and render rollback_ref and activation_scope.
capabilities.limitation: No runtime rollback executor or activation enforcer exists yet.

capabilities.name: Interactive causal playground
capabilities.evidence: site/ supports hypothesis selection, branch visualization, replay display, promote/rollback state.
capabilities.limitation: Browser replay values are demo fixtures; Promote/Rollback only change local UI state.

capabilities.name: Generic JSON / JSONL trace ingestion
capabilities.evidence: CI compiles raw decision/outcome traces into Evolution Packets with evidence and provenance.
capabilities.limitation: Live GitHub, agent-framework, and observability adapters are not implemented yet.

capabilities.name: Trace -> measured replay -> Behavior Proof
capabilities.evidence: The prove CLI compiles a trace, selects a candidate, executes real replay commands, and renders the report.
capabilities.limitation: Selection is heuristic unless the user explicitly supplies a mutation surface.

capabilities.name: Active discrimination across competing interventions
capabilities.evidence: The discriminate CLI runs the same baseline cases across multiple mutation surfaces and reports survivors, falsified variants, or ambiguity.
capabilities.limitation: It only discriminates among supplied executable interventions; it does not discover arbitrary interventions automatically.

capabilities.name: Trace -> multi-intervention discrimination -> guarded selection
capabilities.evidence: The evolve CLI compiles a raw trace, runs competing executable interventions on the same cases, selects only a unique survivor, and leaves ambiguous runs unselected.
capabilities.limitation: Candidate interventions still need executable commands supplied by the experiment manifest.

capabilities.name: Heuristic causal hypothesis proposals
capabilities.evidence: Deterministic rules rank candidate mutation surfaces from trace state, corrections, guards, and explicit hints.
capabilities.limitation: This is not learned causal inference and does not prove a unique root cause.

capabilities.name: Live PR / review / CI / framework trace adapters
capabilities.limitation: Current ingestion starts from exported JSON or JSONL traces.

capabilities.name: Captured counterfactual world forks
capabilities.limitation: Command replay can compare executions, but does not snapshot and restore arbitrary worlds.

capabilities.name: Automatic Evolution PR open / merge / revert
capabilities.limitation: No GitHub automation is wired into the EvoPR runtime yet.

capabilities.name: Shadow / canary / automatic rollback
capabilities.limitation: No online traffic router is implemented.
